Synopsis:
Missouri's AG is petitioning the U.S. Supreme Court on an emergency basis to reinstate a Republican-drawn congressional map for upcoming midterm elections. A state Supreme Court ruling blocked the map, requiring voter referendum approval before it can take effect. The dispute is part of a broader Trump-backed mid-decade redistricting effort that has already shifted the balance in ~22 congressional districts nationally. With Republicans holding a razor-thin 219-214 House majority, the outcome directly bears on which party controls the House post-midterms.
